name: EOSP Main Merge Probe

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - automation/eosp-main-merge-probe-20260907
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/eosp-main-merge-probe.yml

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  probe:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout closed branch baseline
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: def83da3706882669e92b3de4f1bc1ee8475f8b8

      - name: Configure Git identity
        run: |
          git config user.name "Monad EOS Automation"
          git config user.email "eos-automation@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Probe merge from main
        run: |
          git fetch origin main
          set +e
          git merge --no-ff --no-commit origin/main
          rc=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "MERGE_CONFLICTS_BEGIN"
            git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U | sort
            echo "MERGE_CONFLICTS_END"
            git status --short
            exit 20
          fi
          echo "MERGE_PROBE: CLEAN"

      - name: Validate merged EOS state
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/test_event_ledger_merge.py
          python3 tools/eos/test_canonical_state.py
          python3 tools/eos/test_canonical_reconciliation.py
          python3 tools/eos/test_wrapper_dispatch.py
          python3 tools/eos/test_identifier_families.py
          ./scripts/eos state status
          ./scripts/eos verify
          git diff --check -- . ':!.eos/*.tsv'

      - name: Commit validated merge result
        run: |
          git add -A
          git commit -m "merge: reconcile main into AI-driven engineering branch"

      - name: Publish immutable merge result
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/automation/eosp-main-merge-result-20260907
